Hi Alex / Sam —

Great to meet you earlier — quick recap and a few asks so we can do a focused unit-econ deep-dive:

Recap:
- Primary use cases you called out: Chat Assist (customer support augmentation), Summarization for compliance, and Search/Embeddings for knowledge retrieval.
- Target go-live: pilot in Q4 with a broader rollout in Q1.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm estimated monthly token volumes by feature (ballpark is fine): Chat Assist / Summarization / Embeddings.
2) What is your procurement budget range for inference (monthly or $/1M tokens target)? A range helps us map to commitment tiers.
3) Any procurement constraints (SLA, PO timing, security questionnaire owners)?

We’ll prepare: a short unit-economics memo showing estimated Redwood inference cost vs proposed customer price (per 1M tokens), $/feature breakdown, and CAC/payback scenarios based on your estimated ARR per pilot. If you can share the monthly volumes in the attached spreadsheet, we’ll run the numbers and get back with concrete scenarios.

Proposed next step: send volumes this week; we'll follow up with a 30-min unit-econ review.

Thanks —
Marissa

Procurement: we’ll need a short cost model and a sample PO/contract for review. Looping in procurement for timelines — they’ll aim to review contracts next week.

Happy to take the unit-econ review call on Wed 29th PT if that works for your team.

Alex — thanks for the volumes and the target range. I pulled together a short set of scenarios (summary below) and attached our 2026 pricing reference (redwood_pricing_reference_2026.pdf) for commitment tiers. We’ll convert the attached volumes into an explicit unit-econ memo before the call.

Quick scenarios (ballpark; per 1M tokens):
- Estimated Redwood infra & ops cost for this workload (optimized open models + batching/kv caching): $40–$70 per 1M tokens (range reflects model variant and sequence length).
- Suggested customer-facing price tiers (list price / 1M tokens):
  • Starter (monthly <50M tokens): $400 / 1M
  • Business (50–300M tokens): $250 / 1M
  • Enterprise (300M+ tokens, committed): $150 / 1M

Applying FintechX mix (150M chat, 40M summarization, 10M embeddings = 200M total):
- At Business tier ($250 / 1M): gross margin midpoint ~ (250 - 55) / 250 ≈ 78% (using $55 infra cost midpoint).
- At Enterprise tier ($150 / 1M): margin midpoint ~ (150 - 55) / 150 ≈ 63%.

$ / feature (monthly) — using Business tier for examples:
- Chat Assist (150M @ $250): $37,500 / month
- Summarization (40M @ $250): $10,000 / month
- Embeddings (10M @ $250): $2,500 / month
- Total monthly spend (example): $50,000 -> annualized ~$600k

CAC / payback — illustrative (we’ll refine with your ARR per pilot / expansion numbers):
- Assume Redwood CAC for a mid-market deal (sales + onboarding + SE time) = $45k blended.
- Pilot -> conversion to paid with average annual contract of $600k (above): payback ~ 1 month (45k / 600k ≈ 0.075). If the pilot converts to a smaller $200k ARR, payback ~ 2.7 months.

Notes / asks for the memo:
- If you have target margin thresholds (e.g., require >60% gross margin) or payback goals for procurement, call them out and we’ll show scenarios that meet them.
- Confirm whether embeddings will be billed at same per-token rate or via a different pricing metric (we can propose a bundling option).

Next steps: we’ll prepare a one-page unit-econ memo and run the numbers into the attached spreadsheet, then review on Wed 29th PT. Marissa — can you lock 30 minutes and invite the FintechX team?

Thanks —
Rishi
